name: app-super-app-green-glow-hands-mockup
title: Super-app home screen held in green-lit hands
whatItIs: Two hands, tinted deep green, hold a phone showing a white super-app home screen with an illustrated city header, a search bar, a balance card and a grid of illustrated service tiles (ride, car, food, send, mart). The background is a green radial gradient into black.
whatItMeans: Vibrant and modern; the monochrome green scene makes the bright screen the only light source.
techniques: Tint the photo of hands in the brand colour so the screen glows.
Use a dark radial gradient to focus attention.
Give service tiles colourful isometric illustrations.
Pair a big balance card with quick actions (pay, top up).

vocabulary.definition: Colouring a photo in one hue.
A glow that fades to dark at the edges.
An icon drawn from a 3D angle.
